carrier_contract.failure_semantics: A missing, unreadable, non-UTF-8, or invalid-JSON carrier is invalid_input and preserves output.
carrier_contract.literal: --chunks accepts the frozen literal CHUNKS_JSON form unchanged.
carrier_contract.path: When the exact --chunks argument begins with @, the remaining text is a caller-supplied path whose exact strict UTF-8 contents are interpreted as CHUNKS_JSON.
carrier_contract.semantic_equivalence: For identical JSON bytes, literal and @PATH carriers have identical parsing, validation, chunk boundaries, output, and diagnostics.

reason: Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN cannot carry some valid frozen inputs: hexadecimal JSON for the smallest nonzero endian-symmetric frame length 65792 exceeds the per-argument limit, while the frozen profile permits up to 2 MiB decoded input.
